parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of PolyFit not being robust to missing data by dropping NaN values. However, it lacks comprehensive testing and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the change correctly handles missing data in various scenarios.
The PR does not update the documentation to reflect the change in behavior regarding missing data.
